subject: Draft: Solvexa MAP + trial evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@solvexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft: Solvexa MAP + trial evaluation timeline

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together a very lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short slide timeline for the 30-day trial and evaluation run. The goal here is to make it easy for your engineering and procurement teams to see milestones, owners, and gating criteria.

What I attached:
- MAP-template-v1.gdoc — single-page MAP (milestones, owners, success criteria)
- close-timeline-slides.gslides — 3-slide timeline and suggested meeting cadence

Proposed high-level timeline (subject to your availability):
- Week 0 (Kickoff): access + test data ingest, security checklist review (owner: Solvexa Eng / Redwood SE)
- Week 1–2 (Validation): model eval against 3 scenarios, latency/cost baseline, initial integration
- Week 3 (Acceptance): acceptance test, acceptance criteria sign-off, procurement checklist
- Week 4 (Go/no-go + next steps): review results, finalize commercial terms if green

Request: Can you confirm the primary technical contact for the trial and whether your procurement team prefers DocuSign or a PO to lock the pilot? If you like, we can add your stakeholders directly to the MAP doc and schedule a 30‑minute kickoff for Tuesday or Wednesday next week.

I also flagged a couple of compliance checkpoints in the doc (SOC2 scope, data handling) — Jasmine will coordinate evidence requests if needed.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning on owners.

— Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-template-v1.gdoc (Google Doc stub), close-timeline-slides.gslides (Google Slides stub)

From: Elena Rossi <elena@solvexa.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@solvexa.com
Date: 2026-09-08T12:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Solvexa MAP + trial evaluation timeline

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the templates, this looks helpful. I shared the MAP with our engineering lead (Marco) and procurement. A couple of quick notes:

- Primary technical contact: Marco Valenti (marco@solvexa.com) — he will do the hands-on validation.
- Procurement prefers a PO for pilots under $25k; anything above that they want a short SOW + PO. Will confirm exact threshold tomorrow.
- Can you add a short line in the MAP about data retention (we need retention < 30 days for this trial)?

We’re good to kick off next Wednesday (2026-09-16) at 10:00am PT if that works for your team — Marco, Elena, and procurement will attend. Please add Marco to the doc and I’ll loop in any additional stakeholders after procurement confirms the budget path.

Elena
Head of Platform, Solvexa
